entities.summary: Anton Lazarev is a Russian professional ice hockey forward currently playing with HC Kunlun Red Star in the Kontinental Hockey League (KHL). Lazarev previously signed a two-year contract with Avtomobilist Yekaterinburg after two seasons with Metallurg Novokuznetsk on May 8, 2013.
